name: Receiver
description: Acoustic Receiver object (microphone, human ear, etc.) with an orientation: the direction it faces and its up direction, which set the frame of ambisonic responses (x facing, y left, z up).

inputParameters.name: direction
inputParameters.description: Direction the receiver faces (default +x): the x axis of its ambisonic responses.

inputParameters.name: up
inputParameters.description: Up direction of the receiver (default +z): the z axis of its ambisonic responses.

inputParameters.name: plane
inputParameters.description: Optional: position and orientation as a plane (x axis facing, z axis up). Overrides position, direction and up.

outputParameters.name: plane
outputParameters.description: The receiver's orientation as a plane: x axis facing, y axis left, z axis up.
